}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== :[https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/next-gen-firewall/sd-red-sd-wan-edge-device Product page] *
"RED 20 MB VER:C", "4BQ00REDC2X10" and "ASSEMBLED IN TAIWAN" :are silkscreened on top of the board.
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[NXP]] LS1012A @800MHz :Single-core ARM (Cortex-A53) *Flash: 128MB (NAND), 2MB (NOR) *Memory: 512MB (DDR3) SDRAM *Network: 4x Gigabit Ethernet ports, :1x SFP/RJ45 Gigabit port *USB: 2x USB 3.0 ports *Expansion: 1x PCIe module *Power: 12V, 3A via barrel (redundant)
